translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Yin̈tilal vin̈aj Adán
Aton yab'ixal eb' yin̈tilal vin̈aj Adán tic d'a stzolal. Ayic ix b'oji eb' anima yuj Dios, icha Dios ix aj eb'.
Ix b'oji vin̈ vinac yed' pax ix ix, ix yac'anpax svach'c'olal d'a yib'an̈ eb'. Atax d'a jun c'u chi' ayic ix b'ojiel eb' yuuj, anima
ix sb'iejcan eb' yuuj.
A vin̈aj Adán chi', 130 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji junxo yuninal vin̈ scuchan Set, lajan ix aj yed' smam chi'.
Ix lajvi chi', 800 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈aj Adán chi'. Ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
930 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Set chi', 105 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Enós.
Ix lajvi chi', 807 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈, ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
912 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Enós chi', 90 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Cainán.
Ix lajvi chi', 815 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈, ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
905 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Cainán chi', 70 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Mahalalel.
Ix lajvi chi', 840 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈, ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
910 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Mahalalel chi', 65 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Jared.
Ix lajvi chi', 830 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈, ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
895 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Jared chi', 162 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Enoc.
Ix lajvi chi', 800 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈, ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
962 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Enoc chi', 65 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Matusalén.
Yictax ix alji yuninal vin̈ chi', 300 ab'il ix sc'anab'ajej Dios vin̈. D'a jun tiempoal chi', ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
365 ab'il ix yil vin̈.
Ix sb'eyb'alej val vin̈ icha sgana Dios, yuj chi' ay jun c'u ix satem vin̈, yujto a Dios ix ic'anb'at vin̈ yed'oc.
A vin̈aj Matusalén chi', 187 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈ scuchan Lamec.
Ix lajvi chi' 782 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈, ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
969 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Lamec chi', 182 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix alji jun yuninal vin̈.
Noé
ix sb'iej yuj vin̈ yujto ix yal vin̈: A Jehová ix catab'an lum luum tic, yuj chi' te ya co munlaj d'a sat luum, palta a vin̈ unin tic ol ac'an snivanil co c'ool, xchi vin̈aj Lamec chi'.
Ayic toxo ix alji vin̈aj Noé chi', 595 ab'ilto ix yil vin̈aj Lamec chi', ayto yuninal vin̈ yed' yisil vin̈ ix alji.
777 ab'il ix yil vin̈, ix cham vin̈ b'ian.
A vin̈aj Noé chi', 500 ab'il sq'uinal vin̈ ayic ix syamanoch yalji eb' yuninal vin̈, aton vin̈aj Sem, vin̈aj Cam yed' vin̈aj Jafet.

footnotes.text: A d'a hebreo a jun b'i scuch Noé, lajan yalji yed' jun lolonel “ic'oj ip”.
